scope: Repository-defined legacy energy carbon-intensity compatibility fields in the location-scoped Kernel summary

implementation.formula: active registered carbon_offset_kg sum / 12; 30-day reviewed fixed-factor emissions minus that offset estimate
implementation.display_status: advisory; stored offset declarations are not independently verified; negative net values are not clamped

limitations: Synthetic values verify compatibility arithmetic and response validation only; they do not establish populated farm-output parity.
The legacy estimate is not a verified carbon inventory, lifecycle assessment, or certification result.
